about: CourtLens has no version numbers: a release is a merge to main (its pull request) or, for work not yet merged, its branch. Each entry links the commit that shipped it.

releases.title: Research
releases.version: research branch, not yet merged to main
releases.summary: The Research menu: models tested on seasons they never saw, each with a registered protocol, frozen results and evidence.

entries.title: Win Probability
entries.text: A live win-probability model for every game, frozen and scored each night against ESPN's, with its final-test report.
bullets: Models and final test on held-out seasons (9b53fbb).
Frozen model, nightly scorecard and drift flag.

entries.title: Projected Impact
entries.text: CourtLens's own player rating with aging curves. Its 2026-27 projections were frozen before the games they are scored on.

entries.title: Lineup Model
entries.text: A lineup model with learned player vectors, tested against ridge RAPM on held-out stints, with a lineup tool and a player map.

entries.title: Impact history and intervals
entries.text: Twelve regular seasons of RAPM computed from public play-by-play, with time decay, bootstrap intervals and dated rating snapshots.

entries.title: Six-Factor RAPM
entries.text: Player impact split into shooting, turnovers and rebounding on both ends, with an Impact Tree.
bullets: Redesigned after Databallr's Six-Factor explainer, with shared Research components (4023a98, 2026-11-06).

entries.title: Metric Backtest
entries.text: Nine impact metrics, each fixed before every game, ranked by how well they predict real results.

entries.title: zTS
entries.text: True shooting adjusted for play-type difficulty, with a registered test against rTS.

entries.title: Shot Quality
entries.text: An expected-points shot model built from free shot and play-by-play data, and each player's shot-making above it.

entries.title: Defensive Shot Quality
entries.text: What shooters scored against each defender compared with their own shooting, and the shot quality / shot-making split of true shooting.

entries.title: Signal vs Noise
entries.text: How many attempts each stat needs before it reflects skill, and shrunk shooting percentages, also available as a Stats toggle.

entries.title: Draft Classes
entries.text: What each draft slot returned since 1966, every class redrafted, and this season's rookies against past picks at their slot.

entries.title: Wingspan and calculator data
entries.text: Wingspan beside career defensive DPM, and each season's observed four-factor inputs on the ORtg calculator.

entries.title: Research menu
entries.text: Regrouped into Models, Impact, Shooting, Methods and Tools. Workload Trends, Distributions & Splits and the Blog were removed.

log.heading: 2026-11-05 — Research menu trimmed, dropped pages removed (owner request, part of R12)
